post.description: Mints the grant every request to the autocomplete tier carries in ``X-Autocomplete-Session``. Minting writes one Order and is rate limited per organization, per ten-minute window and per rolling day, one pool drawn from by every caller in it; the keystrokes it admits write nothing. The grant is bound to the ``Origin`` it was minted with, expires after ``expires_in`` seconds (refresh at about 80% of it) and admits ``request_budget`` requests per route. A caller whose ``autocomplete.enabled`` override is off is answered 403; a locked organization is answered 402; a sandbox application is answered 422, since sandbox searches resolve against fixtures.

v1.AutocompleteSessionGrantResponse.description: The grant a caller presents to the autocomplete tier.

session_token.description: Opaque, signed session grant. Send it verbatim in the ``X-Autocomplete-Session`` header of every autocomplete request; it carries its own expiry and budget.
session_token.title: Session Token

expires_in.description: Seconds until the grant expires. Mint the next one at about 80% of this so expiry never lands on the typing path.
expires_in.title: Expires In

request_budget.description: Requests this session may make per autocomplete route. Past it the tier answers 429 with ``session_budget_spent``; the remedy is a new session, not a retry.
request_budget.title: Request Budget

pivot_allowance.description: How many times this session may change its query to a different name before the tier refuses it (429, code 482). Growing, trimming or correcting the name being typed never counts.
pivot_allowance.title: Pivot Allowance

filter_min_stem.description: Characters the query needs before the ``person.*``, ``address.*`` and ``state`` filters narrow the suggestions; shorter, a filtered request is a 422 naming ``q``.
filter_min_stem.title: Filter Min Stem

v1.AutocompleteSessionGrantResponse.title: AutocompleteSessionGrantResponse (v1)
